segments.text: Ok so this is the Shared State page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page says ask the agent for the priority and it answers high.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. After clicking mark high priority, the panel shows high, but the agent says it can't tell the priority.
So basically, the agent never sees the state the app sets.
Antigravity needs the app state option turned on and a prompt to read it, and the Angular page never shows that.
Alright, that's the issue, kindly sort it out.
